    04 / THE EXPERIENCE BEHIND THE WORK

    The work
    behind the thinking.

    These reconstructions draw on my experience in customer operations, AI workflows and product development. They use fictional customers, policies and data.

    01

    BLINKIT / BLINKBUDDY

    From “what should I get?”
    to a useful next step.

    Discovery · Digital & voice

    Product discovery, gifting, meal planning and post-purchase support. My contribution connected customer needs with intents, prompts, knowledge content and testable conversation paths on Nugget.

    02

    BLINKIT + ZOMATO / EVA

    A resolution that remembers
    the conversation.

    Order support · Returns · Refunds

    Shared customer-support journeys across both businesses. I worked on issue capture, decision rules, prompt refinement, voice and digital conversations, testing and context-preserving human handovers.

    03

    MINDPEERS / PRODUCT INTERNSHIP

    Make a little room
    for play.

    Product development · Wellbeing games

    Development, debugging and functional testing in a wellbeing-product setting, including game experiences. This new prototype explores clear instructions, gentle feedback, accessible controls and a low-pressure finish.
